name: chrome-beacon
provenance: Captured 2026-08-24 from the same headed Chromium 152.0.0.0 session as chrome-pixel, this time from navigator.sendBeacon(url, string) to a local header-echo server. Verbatim apart from the dropped Host, Connection, Origin and Content-Length headers. The wildcard Accept and the text/plain Content-Type are what sendBeacon itself sends.
